points.description: States the final area of the shaded region as 7π/6 − √3/2 (equivalent forms such as (7π − 3√3)/6 are acceptable). The working must be valid: large semicircle area 2π, minus the union of the three radius-1 semicircles, which is 3π/2 minus the two upper-half lens overlaps of (π/3 − √3/4) each, giving 5π/6 + √3/2. Full mark only if the answer is correct and every step is valid.

rubric.notes: The question has a single exact answer, so the mark is all-or-nothing and depends on the final expression being 7π/6 − √3/2 with valid working. Equivalent algebraic forms and alternative valid methods earn the mark. Any invalid step, such as ignoring the overlap between the middle semicircle and the outer two, earns no mark.
